lead: A beam of light that keeps running around a container's border: a decorative highlight for sign-in panels, featured cards, AI modules and key calls to action. It is purely decorative (`aria-hidden`, lets the pointer through) and must not stand in for focus, validation or status borders; it is hidden entirely when the system asks for reduced motion.

basic.title: Basic
basic.panelText: Review task status, deployment health, and recent automation activity in one panel.

hover.title: Show on hover
hover.panelText: The border beam appears when the pointer moves over this card.

count.title: Multiple beams
count.panelText: Set count to distribute multiple beams evenly around the container border.

size.title: Size, width and speed
size.compactText: Keeps the highlight shorter and faster for dense card groups.
size.extendedText: A longer, calmer highlight for wider feature panels.

custom.title: Custom container and color
custom.description: BorderBeam is itself the container, so anything goes inside; set `radius` to match the content's corners. Switch colors to check that each beam follows its own border.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The container, with `data-radius` / `data-trigger`; the `--bb-*` variables hold the values the component writes
styling.layer: A mask over the container that only shows the border ring (`aria-hidden`, lets the pointer through)
styling.beam: A square gradient moving along the border path; `--bb-index` is its number
